description: This file contains the definition of the Error class within the Opencart Admin Controller Startup namespace, including methods for handling errors and exceptions in the OpenCart admin system.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling and logging system errors and exceptions in the admin startup process of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up error and exception handlers, initializes logging based on configuration.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles runtime PHP errors by logging and displaying or redirecting as configured.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions by logging details and displaying or redirecting as configured.
